modalities.evidence: a routine obstetric ultrasound was performed
Data regarding anthropometric, nutritional and demographic characteristics

output.population: 272 patients initially included in a low-risk outpatient clinic, October 2016 to December 2017, with 211 cases after loss to follow-up
output.summary: Prospective study data pairing ultrasound measurements of maternal epigastric and periumbilical visceral and subcutaneous fat with anthropometric, nutritional and demographic characteristics and outcomes recorded at labor and delivery.
